meta.name: code-documenter
meta.description: Generates, formats, and validates technical documentation — including docstrings, OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc annotations, doc portals, and user guides. Use when adding docstrings to functions or classes, creating API documentation, building documentation sites, or writing tutorials and user guides. Invoke for OpenAPI/Swagger specs, JSDoc, doc portals, getting started guides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码自动生成并维护技术文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为代码编写或更新文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate and maintain technical documentation for your code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to write or update documentation for your code

howto.what: Claude 会帮你生成、整理和检查技术文档：比如给代码加注释、写 API 说明、建文档网站、写用户指南。它会先问格式偏好，再找出没写文档的代码，统一注释风格，测试示例能运行，最后给出覆盖报告。
howto.when: 当你说到 documentation、docstrings、OpenAPI 等关键词，或要求给代码加注释、写 API 文档、建文档网站等时触发。

say.text: 帮我的 Python 函数加上 Google 风格的 docstring
say.note: Claude 会先问格式偏好再动手。

say.text: 给这个 TypeScript 项目写 JSDoc 注释
say.note: 会识别框架并生成带参数和返回类型的注释。

say.text: 把我写的接口整理成 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范
say.note: 会生成规范文件并验证格式。

howto.what_en: Claude generates, formats, and validates technical documentation (docstrings, API specs, user guides). It asks for format preferences, finds undocumented code, applies consistent style, tests examples, and produces a coverage report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions documentation, docstrings, or OpenAPI, or asks for code comments, API specs, or doc sites.

say_en.text: Add Google-style docstrings to my Python functions.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about format preferences first.

say_en.text: Write JSDoc annotations for this TypeScript project.
say_en.note: It detects the framework and writes comments with types.

say_en.text: Convert my API into OpenAPI/Swagger spec.
say_en.note: It generates and validates the spec file.
